Threat: Payment system breach via third-party vendor
Mitigation: Network segmentation between vendor access and payment systems; PCI-DSS compliant processor
Security awareness training; MFA on all email accounts

Threat: Unauthorized access from outside the store
Mitigation: WPA3 encryption; guest network separated from internal network
Offline/immutable backups; least-privilege access to the database

Threat: Password reuse leading to account takeover
Mitigation: Unique passwords via a password manager; mandatory MFA

Threat: DDoS attack during a sales event
Mitigation: DDoS protection service via hosting provider/CDN
